title: Junior Consultants (student) within Data, AI & Technology – start February 2027
description_md:
Do you want to help shape the future of Denmark’s largest companies?  
Are you curious about digital transformation, passionate about working with data and technology, and eager to see your skills make a real difference? If so, you could be PA’s next junior consultant.

We are looking for ambitious students from data, digital management, AI, business informatics,  technology, and engineering backgrounds to join our vibrant student team. As a junior consultant, you’ll join experienced colleagues and work directly with clients from day one.

You’ll tackle real client challenges across diverse industries and the public sector – exploring how AI can drive business value, supporting digital transformation journeys, evaluating technologies, delivering impactful data insights, contributing to digital strategies, and helping translate technical possibilities into strategic decisions. You’ll collaborate closely with both technology and business specialists, while also taking ownership of your own analyses, deliverables, and responsibilities. This hands-on experience gives you a unique opportunity to accelerate your professional and personal growth.

As a junior consultant, you will be involved in many different types of tasks such as:

* Delivering client projects together with a team of experienced consultants.

* Applying data analytics, AI and other digital knowledge to concrete business and organisational challenges.

* Supporting development of digital project management, analytical models, prototypes, tools, and data-driven solutions.

* Translating complex technical findings into actionable insights, clear presentations, and recommendations for clients.

* Working alongside business, digital, and technology specialists on transformation journeys.

* Contributing ideas and materials for proposals and business development across PA’s sectors.

* Helping facilitate workshops and collaborative sessions, internally and externally.

* Engaging users and stakeholders to ensure solutions are relevant, practical, and easy to adopt.

You will be challenged from the beginning, but you will not be expected to know everything from day one. You will get to work both independently and in teams within a flexible working environment with a deep understanding of your studies. As a student, you will be part of a professional workplace while also having the opportunity to join weekly social activities.

We believe that value is created in collaboration and by working shoulder-to-shoulder with our clients. You will be part of an international environment where we value teamwork, sparring and feedback. It is also an environment that requires learning and new knowledge so that we can deliver brilliant work to our clients. With us, you will follow the latest developments in the field, while at the same time having access to training and certifications. We are therefore looking for someone with an open and curious approach to solving challenges and who is driven by acquiring new knowledge.

Your employment starts with a thorough introduction to PA and consulting. From day one, you will also have a dedicated manager and buddy to support your development and help you pursue the areas and projects that match your interests.

* You are in the last year of your bachelor’s degree or the first year of your master's degree.

* You study digital management, data science, business informatics, computer science, engineering, mathematics, AI/machine learning or another relevant discipline.

* You are methodically and analytically strong and have the ability to quickly familiarise yourself with and solve complex problems.

* You are among the most talented in your year.

* You are ambitious, enthusiastic, and motivated to deliver great results.

You have good interpersonal and communication skills, and you are fluent in English, both in writing and speech.

If the above sounds interesting to you, do not wait to apply! We will be conducting interviews during November and December. 
If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Sanna Austrell at sanna.austrell@paconsulting.com 
 
Send us your CV, application and exam transcripts through our career site. We do not accept applications by email. 
Application deadline: November 15th, 2026.  
About us  
We believe in the power of ingenuity to build a positive human future. As strategies, technologies and innovation collide, we create opportunity from complexity. Our diverse teams of experts combine innovative thinking and breakthrough use of technologies to progress further, faster. Our clients adapt and transform, and together we achieve enduring results. An innovation and transformation consultancy, we are over 4000 specialists in consumer and manufacturing, defence and security, energy and utilities, financial services, government and public services, health and life sciences, and transport. Our people are strategists, innovators, designers, consultants, digital experts, scientists, engineers and technologists.  
We operate globally from offices across the UK, US, Netherlands and Nordics.  
PA. Bringing Ingenuity to Life.  
Inclusion & Diversity  
We believe that diversity makes us a stronger firm and look to employ people with different ideas, styles and skill sets. This diversity stimulates a rich, creative environment – one in which our people develop, and our clients enjoy enduring results. We’re committed to recruiting, promoting and rewarding our people solely based on their ability to contribute to PA’s goals, without regard to their sex, race, disability, religion, national origin, ethnicity, sexual orientation, military service obligation, age or marital status.
